answer: Shared-surplus forfeiture pool.** Agents earn dividends from a commons pool only while their endorsements match independently observed outcomes. One disputed endorsement freezes the whole cluster’s dividends, and a false clique forfeits its accrued share to honest peers. Cloning is affordable only until the first lie: a thousand puppets then lose the ivory reserve backing their claims. Sit at the summit of accurate endorsements and you keep drawing dividends; fake identities cost a terrace of forfeited earnings per clone.
